The steps involved in performing PCA are: standardize the data, compute the covariance matrix, compute the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix, sort the eigenvalues in descending order and select the top k eigenvalues, and form a feature vector from the top k eigenvectors and transform the original dataset into the new subspace.
